site.audience: professionals, remote teams, and enterprises seeking async video communication tools

brief.title: ClipCast — One video is worth a thousand words
brief.one_liner: A free screen recorder and async video messaging platform that helps teams communicate faster with AI-powered video creation, editing, and sharing.
brief.goal: Convert visitors into free users and enterprise customers by showcasing the product's screen recording, AI-powered editing, and collaboration features across use cases like sales, engineering, design, and support.

pages.objective: Introduce the product, highlight key features (screen recording, AI bug reports, editing, sharing, security), show social proof, and drive signups.
Sell the enterprise plan by emphasizing async video benefits, security, scalability, integrations, and social proof from large organizations.
Present pricing tiers (Starter, Business, Business + AI, Enterprise) with detailed feature comparison and FAQs to help users choose the right plan.
Allow existing users to log in via social providers (Google, Slack, Apple, Outlook, SSO) or email.
Enable new users to create an account via Google or email with a testimonial for social proof.
